fact: The Statistician-General says the National Strategy for the Development of Statistics was launched in 2025 and the Bureau will implement its reforms in 2026; no period is given in this document.
system: National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS)

fact: The Federal Government unveiled the National Strategy for the Development of Statistics 2024-2028, the third NSDS, on 15 December 2025, described by the Budget Minister as the blueprint for the national statistical system over four to five years.
The NBS catalogue states the second NSDS, 2017-2021, expired, after which the National Consultative Committee on Statistics recommended designing NSDS III; the NSDS II period ended in 2021.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): NSDS 2024-2028.
